title: Reply: the self-refutation charge assumes the folk theory it is meant to defend

statements.text: What the eliminativist is trying to say is that folk psychology is seriously inadequate as a theory. Within that framework the eliminativist must be described as believing there are no beliefs, but only because no alternative framework is yet available. Once the old framework is replaced, the criticism can be restated in the new vocabulary with no pragmatic contradiction. The objection presupposes the folk principle that asserting requires believing.

sources.quote: What the eliminativist is fumbling to say is that folk psychology is seriously inadequate as a theory.
So the eliminativist will hold that the self-refutation critics beg the question against eliminative materialism.
